summary: Kandal M Venture Ltd filed a 6-K announcing a 1-for-40 share consolidation of its Class A and Class B ordinary shares, effective at the open on October 13, 2026, when Class A shares begin trading post-consolidation on Nasdaq Capital Market under symbol FMFC and new CUSIP G5225N126. The stated objective is regaining compliance with Nasdaq Marketplace Rule 5550(a)(2) and maintaining listing. Outstanding shares fall from 19,694,940 to 492,374, with fractional shares rounded up; board approved August 28, 2026 and shareholders September 22, 2026. Watch Nasdaq bid-price compliance and potential reverse-split overhang.
